tool.name: Solvent Laplacian Calculator
tool.description: Compute Laplacian (second derivative) analysis of solvent density from RISM calculations
tool.command: ln -s $kh_O_zero_dx out.kh.O.0.dx && metatwist --dx out.kh.O.0.dx --species $species_value --convolve $convolve_value --sigma $sigma_value --odx out.kh.O.dx > $lp_file && mv out.kh.O.dx $kh_O_dx

param.name: kh_O_zero_dx
param.label: KH potential density map (kh.O.0.dx)
param.help: Upload the KH potential density map file for oxygen from RISM calculations (e.g., 1aho.kh.O.0.dx).

param.name: species_value
param.label: Species to analyze
param.help: Specify the solvent species to analyze Laplacian for (e.g., O for oxygen atoms).

param.name: convolve_value
param.label: Convolution kernel size
param.help: Set the kernel size for convolution smoothing (0 = no convolution, typical values: 1-5).

param.name: sigma_value
param.label: Gaussian smoothing sigma
param.help: Set the sigma value for Gaussian kernel smoothing (0.0 = no smoothing, typical values: 0.0-2.0 Angstrom).

tool.help:
.. class:: infomark
**What it does**
Computes the Laplacian (second spatial derivative) of solvent density maps from RISM calculations. The Laplacian reveals structural features such as peaks (favorable binding sites), valleys (unfavorable regions), and inflection points in the solvation structure, helping identify local hydration organization patterns.
-----
**Key Features**
- **Laplacian calculation**: Computes second derivatives of density maps - **Gaussian smoothing**: Optional pre-filtering for noise reduction - **Convolution methods**: Flexible kernel-based analysis options - **OpenDX format**: Compatible with standard molecular visualization tools - **Single species focus**: Analyze oxygen or other specific solvent components
-----
**Inputs**
- **KH potential density map**: Oxygen density map from RISM calculations - **Species to analyze**: Specify which solvent component to focus on - **Convolution kernel size**: Kernel size for convolution (0 = none) - **Gaussian sigma**: Standard deviation for Gaussian smoothing filter
-----
**Outputs**
- **Laplacian results file (out.lp)**: Computed Laplacian values at each grid point - **Processed density map (out.kh.O.dx)**: Optional smoothed/filtered density map
-----
**Parameters**
+-------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------+ | Parameter | Description | +===================+=============================================================+ | Convolution size | Kernel size for convolution filtering (0 = no filtering) | +-------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------+ | Gaussian sigma | Smoothing width for Gaussian filter (0.0 = no smoothing) | +-------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------+ | Species | Solvent atom type to analyze (typically 'O' for water) | +-------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------+
-----
**Notes**
- Laplacian values show structural organization: positive = density maxima, negative = density minima - Smoothing parameters should be adjusted based on map resolution - Output can be visualized in molecular graphics software (UCSF Chimera, PyMOL, VMD)
